rewrites/2021_09_is-invest-in-gold-is-go: Is it worth investing $10,000 in gold?

It can be, as one part of a diversified portfolio. Many advisers suggest keeping gold to about 5–10% of your investments: it tends to hold value when stocks and currencies fall, but it pays no interest or dividends and can drop sharply, as it did in 2026. Low-cost gold ETFs or sovereign gold bonds avoid the storage and making charges of physical gold.
rewrites/2021_10_investor-psychology-beh: There is no Buffett rule by that name. The rule Buffett actually described, in his 2013 letter to shareholders, is 90/10: he instructed that the money he leaves for his wife be put 90% in a very low-cost S&P 500 index fund and 10% in short-term government bonds. A 70/30 split between stocks and bonds is a common moderate allocation, but it is not his.
rewrites/2021_09_lumpsum-vs-sip-mutual-f: Buffett never set a 70/30 rule. A 70/30 stock and bond mix is simply a common moderate allocation.
rewrites/2023_07_recognizing-telltale-si: How do you deal with a controlling boss?

Agree clear goals and deadlines in writing, then give regular short updates before you are asked, which often reduces micromanagement. Ask which decisions you can make on your own, keep records of instructions, and raise the pattern calmly in a one-to-one. If it turns into bullying, document it and go to HR.

rewrites/2023_08_zen-journey-into-essenc: Can you practice Zen by yourself?

Yes. The core practice, zazen (seated meditation), needs only a quiet place and 10–20 minutes a day: sit upright, follow your breath and gently return to it when your mind wanders. Most teachers still recommend visiting a group or teacher now and then to check your posture and practice.
rewrites/2021_10_the-ultimate-guide-to-a: Can you lose money in an annuity?

Yes, in some cases. Variable annuities invest in the markets and can fall in value; surrender charges can cost you if you cash out in the first years; inflation erodes fixed payments; and an insurer can fail, although state guaranty associations in the US cover annuities up to set limits.
articles/cash-limit-international-flight: Where should I keep cash while traveling?

Split it: carry a day's spending in your wallet, keep the rest in a money belt or hidden pocket under your clothes, and leave a reserve in the hotel safe. Always keep large amounts in your hand luggage, never checked bags, and declare anything above the limit.
articles/explain-layoff-career-gap-inter: How long of a gap is okay on a resume?

A few months is normal and rarely questioned. Gaps of six months or more are common too, but you should be ready to explain them briefly and positively: caring for family, health, study, a layoff, a job search, or freelance work, with what you learned or did in that time.
articles/canada-passport-photo-size.html: What if my passport photo is not exactly the right size?

It will usually be rejected. Passport offices check the exact print size and head size, so a Canadian photo must be 50 × 70 mm with the face 31–36 mm from chin to crown. Have it taken by a commercial photographer who knows the Canadian rules.
articles/china-visa-photo-size.html: What if my visa photo is not the exact size?

The visa centre or online system can reject it and ask for a new one, which delays the application. The China visa photo must be 33 × 48 mm (354–420 × 472–560 pixels online); the photo maker on this page crops it exactly.
articles/schengen-visa-photo-size.html: What are the specifications for a US visa photo?

A US visa photo is different from a Schengen one: square, 2 × 2 inches (51 × 51 mm) printed, or 600 × 600 to 1,200 × 1,200 pixels and under 240 KB as a digital JPEG, with the head 50–69% of the image height, on a white background, without glasses.
rewrites/2021_06_ceo-vs-coo.html: What is the difference between a CEO, COO and CFO?

The CEO (chief executive officer) sets strategy and is ultimately responsible for the company. The COO (chief operating officer) runs day-to-day operations so the strategy gets carried out. The CFO (chief financial officer) manages the money: budgets, accounts, funding and financial risk.
What are common weaknesses in leadership?

Frequent ones are poor communication, micromanaging, avoiding difficult conversations, not delegating, failing to give feedback or recognition, inconsistency, taking credit and passing blame, resisting change, not listening, and burning out by doing everything yourself.
rewrites/2021_09_is-floating-interest-is: Is 1% per month the same as 12% per annum?

Not quite. 1% a month simple interest is 12% a year, but if it compounds monthly the effective annual rate is (1.01)^12 − 1, about 12.68%. Loan agreements in India usually quote the annual rate and compute interest on the reducing monthly balance.
rewrites/2023_04_a-study-on-fixed-intere: Is 1% per month the same as 12% per annum?

Only as simple interest. Compounded monthly, 1% a month works out to about 12.68% a year, because each month's interest also earns interest. Compare loans by their annual percentage rate (APR) to see the true cost.
rewrites/2021_07_how-to-maintain-good-re: What are the rules on relationships in the workplace?

They depend on the employer. Many companies require you to disclose a romantic relationship with a colleague and forbid relationships between a manager and someone they supervise, to avoid conflicts of interest and harassment claims. Check your employee handbook; harassment and discrimination laws apply everywhere.

rewrites/2023_10_parenting-challenges-ad: How can a teenager deal with toxic parents?

Stay safe first: if there is abuse, tell a teacher, school counsellor or relative, or call a child helpline (Childline 1098 in India). Set what boundaries you can, spend time with supportive people, avoid escalating arguments, and remember their behaviour is not your fault. Counselling helps, and things often improve once you have more independence.
rewrites/2021_06_how-to-overcome-introve: How can I help a shy toddler?

Give them time to warm up instead of pushing, prepare them for new places and people, model friendly greetings yourself, praise small brave steps, and avoid labelling them as shy in front of others. Shyness in toddlers is very common and usually eases with age and gentle practice.
rewrites/2023_06_the-enchantment-of-work: Is a work-from-home job worth it?

For many people, yes: no commute, more flexibility and often better focus. The trade-offs are less face time with managers (which can slow promotion), loneliness, and blurred work and home boundaries. It works best with a separate workspace, fixed hours and regular contact with your team.
rewrites/2023_09_artificial-superintelli: How far away is AGI realistically?

No one knows. Forecasts from AI researchers range from a few years to several decades, and some doubt current methods will get there at all. Surveys of researchers have tended to bring their median estimates closer in recent years, but there is no agreed definition or test of AGI to measure progress against.
